retracted_initial_suspicions.reason: Cable turns at the low return and lifted selection responds; U-shaped routing alone is not evidence of a mechanism defect.
Solid lower casing can enclose the stack; lack of visible plates alone does not prove a defective machine.
High output sheave is fixed; the lower moving pulley travels with selected weight. It is not an output-height slider changing midrep.
Native1/3 show reciprocal handlebars and opposing pedal positions.
